name: obs-sglang-scheduler-retraction
notes: _update_after_schedule: 'KV cache pool is full. Retract requests.' retract_decode() returns retracted_reqs plus reqs_to_abort; aborted requests get HTTPStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE ('Retracted under decode memory pressure without a KV backup. Retry later.') or INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR. The warning line logs #retracted_reqs and #new_tokens_gained.
